lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular pixel clusters organized in roughly parallel vertical columns along the mid-lateral flank, transitioning to a higher-density, less-ordered distribution in the posterior region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect horizontal rows of circular blobs, forming a discernible grid-like pattern of high-intensity nodes across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Prominent horizontal linear features observed along the upper third of the visible flank, characterized by a sharp transition from high-intensity pixels on the dorsal edge to localized shadows immediately ventral.
